plugins.name: eca-ecommerce-agent
plugins.description: Ecommerce Academy skills bundle — brand intelligence, email marketing campaigns, competitor analysis, Meta ad copywriting, customer persona building, SEO/AI blog writing, UGC video scripts, SEO/AI store audits, and Meta ads analysis (4PI). New skills are added here over time; install this one plugin to stay current with all of them.

plugins.name: eca-operations-agent
plugins.description: Ecommerce Academy Operations Coworker — the daily running of the store. A morning brief that reads Shopify, Meta Ads and your inbox and tells you what needs doing today, a landing page builder that installs straight into your theme, and a skill builder that turns any repeatable task of yours into a reusable skill.  What's new (v1.36.0): Added in daily bried

plugins.name: eca-black-friday-blueprint
plugins.description: Ecommerce Academy Black Friday Blueprint — everything you need to plan and run BFCM. Decide a data-backed offer from last year's numbers, lock the phase calendar, then build the email programme and the ad creative off the back of it. Three skills sharing one set of campaign files, so the offer, the dates, every send and every ad live in the same runsheet and dashboard. The ads skill needs Higgsfield connected to generate images, and produces a full creative brief and prompt when it is not.
